changelog:
Initial release of Tencent Meeting skill.  
- Schedule and create meetings via REST API.
- Query meeting details by ID or code.
- List and retrieve cloud meeting recordings.
- Extract detailed or AI-optimized meeting transcripts.
- Supports natural language triggers (e.g., "schedule a meeting", "会议转写").
- Setup requires Tencent Meeting Open API credentials.
